sources.text: Cluster owns control plane and worker Machines. Infrastructure providers satisfy infrastructure readiness while bootstrap providers supply initialization data. E2E artifacts are grouped by workload cluster.

architecture.text: Cluster owns control plane and worker Machines, while providers own infrastructure and bootstrap readiness.

diagnostic_lifecycle.text: Cluster infrastructure readiness precedes control plane initialization, worker creation, and conformance tests.

test_flavors.text: Jobs cover management-cluster E2E, workload-cluster conformance, and upgrade templates.

artifacts.purpose: Contains Cluster, Machine, and control-plane resource conditions.

failure_patterns.name: Infrastructure readiness stall
failure_patterns.do_not_conclude: Do not attribute the downstream Machine wait to CAPI core without provider evidence.
failure_patterns.remediation_limit: Fix the owning provider or template only after its condition or log proves the cause.

transient_rules.only_if: The image pull retry succeeds and the affected component becomes ready during the run.
transient_rules.not_transient_if: The image tag is missing or pulls never recover before test failure.

triage_order.text: Correlate the JUnit timeout with Cluster conditions, then the owning provider condition and controller log, and compare a passing workload cluster.

unresolved: Document provider-specific artifact paths in the consumer prompt.
